description: Photovoltaic power potential: A global dataset based on hourly CMIP6-based ISIMIP3b climate model data is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Benjamin Poschlod, Florian Zabel (Universität Hamburg). This dataset provides the photocoltaic power potential as NetCDF files and compiled maps as PNG files. The calculation is based on hourly CMIP6-based ISIMIP3b climate model data (GFDL-ESM4, IPSL-CM6A-LR, MPI-ESM1-2-HR, MRI-ESM2-0, UKESM1-0-LL) across the historical, ssp126, ssp370, and ssp585 experiments. Historical data is provided from 1981-2010 in 5-year slices. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
